historical_cohorts.rule: state at 30-40 games with output below the median of its own position group; picks 1-10 vs picks 40+

meta.censor_left: entry years 2003-2004 excluded: store season rows begin 2005
meta.censor_right: 2026 in progress: contributes no future value, supplies no fitting state
meta.population: ND effective_pick 1-64, entry_year>=2005, state year <= 2019 (H=6 fully observed)
meta.scorer: 26B Layer 2 pricing core (Ruling 1 bars, Ruling 3 season callable, sqrt games weight, no era normalisation), discount re-anchored at the state year
meta.survivorship: zeros stay in; a season with no row contributes 0

P10.claim: one pass, nothing tuned after a reading, breaches owned by number
P10.measured: single execution of this harness; no quantity re-fitted after being read

P2.claim: median R6 < 25% of mean in 16-35 band; >=30% zeros in <=35-game bands

P3.claim: pick still predicts at 16-35 games: matched delta > 0 and v0 coefficient > 0
P3.measured: matched delta quintile lens None (0 usable strata -> the preregistered collapse applies); tercile lens 272.6 over 7 strata; residual contrast gap 67.8 (90% CI [-51.776875152270065, 199.00198856634177]); beta_v0(16-35) 0.21772876584106796 (cluster t 4.096501672785657); beta_v0 full panel 0.4696897584705056
P3.note: scored on the preregistered collapse ladder; the un-collapsed quintile lens is reported alongside and is empty at this band by thinness, not by sign

P4.claim: pedigree share at 36-70 games strictly between 5.6% and 40%, specifically 8-25%

P5.claim: pedigree share non-increasing across games bands (one blip <=2pp allowed)

P6.claim: TRAJECTORY does not clear the 2.0%/4-of-5 bar over LEVEL (seat predicts against the owner)

P7.claim: per-position clocks clear the bar AND tall peak age >= small peak age + 1.0y
P7.measured: adopt=False (-0.55% RMS, 0/5 folds) ; preregistered peak-age lens DEGENERATE (pins to the age-18 boundary in all six groups: the target is REMAINING value, which declines with age for horizon reasons) -> NO SIGNAL on that lens ; supplementary raw growth clock (post-hoc, non-deciding): last positive-growth age tall 27.00 vs small/mid 25.33, gap 1.67

P8.claim: kako: every form predicts remaining 6-season value below his board price 1320; L and T differ by <2x

P9.claim: pool band mean R6 below band A at comparable states

q1_persistence.collapse_ladder: PREREG s3: cell n<8 is not reported; output quintile -> tercile -> stratum dropped. The quintile lens is reported first, the tercile lens is the preregistered collapse, and the residual contrast carries the same claim with the full panel behind it.
